summary: Vistra Operations Company LLC, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Vistra Corp., completed a registered public offering of $850 million of 7.000% Series A Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057 and $650 million of 7.250% Series B Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Vistra. The notes were issued under a September 24, 2026 indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee; the September 10, 2026 underwriting agreement was led by Barclays, BofA, Mizuho, MUFG and Truist. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch for leverage, refinancing and interest-cost effects.
